sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: completing Italian tile manufacturer Casalgrande Padana's Essence line of wood-inspired tiles, Essence Cannetté has a slatted, dimensional surface to bring texture into interiors. The Essence Cannetté tiles are the decorative option in Casalgrande Padana's Essence porcelain stoneware line, which mimics the look of richly-grained larch wood.
